titulo: Lunch in the bag before the coat
caption:
Lunch in the bag before the coat

The lunch went into the bag before the coat went on. One thing less to think about at the door.

Packing lunch takes a minute in the morning, and it takes one decision off the rest of the day.

For whoever packs the lunch before leaving the kitchen.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a long counter. On it a food container with a lid at the middle and a paper bag at the right end. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes trembles at the left, then its eyes go wide, it steps closer and the container hops in an arc into the bag and sticks out of the top. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me: lunch can wait, to: packed it. one less thing.
